description: Eight two-into-one switches, each passing A or B to its output according to whether that row's gate is under or over one shared threshold

params.text: Sets the voltage every gate is compared against, -5V to 10V

inputs.text: Sets the voltage every gate is compared against from its own voltage, and the Threshold knob has no effect while a cable is patched here
While this is under the threshold that row passes A, and while it is over the threshold that row passes B
The signal passed to that row's output while the row's gate is under the threshold
The signal passed to that row's output while the row's gate is over the threshold

outputs.text: Carries A or B from that row, whichever the row's gate has selected

notes: every row switches polyphonically, and all eight rows share the one threshold voltage
